Routing rule learned:
- Option C (“regional office”) is valid for EAST-region requests.
- Option C is invalid for NORTH-region requests.
- Confirmed accepted: east large renewal (REQ-2403) and east small shipment (REQ-2407).
- Request type, amount, sender, urgency, and wording did not override the region-based pattern.
- No evidence yet distinguishing when to use A (standard queue) versus B (priority desk); do not infer their rules.

Routing notes:
- Routing is not determined by region alone; request type (and possibly other attributes) matters.
- Option C is valid for some EAST requests: confirmed east renewal (REQ-2403) and east shipment (REQ-2407).
- Option C is invalid for east transfer (REQ-2411), east large transfer (REQ-2416), and east small invoice (REQ-2419).
- Option C is invalid for NORTH requests based on prior evidence; no successful north-C example.
- Option A is valid for north invoice (REQ-2412) and north large refund (REQ-2414).
- Option A is invalid for north claim (REQ-2410, REQ-2413), north shipment (REQ-2415, REQ-2417), and south renewal (REQ-2418).
- Therefore, previous “C = east” / “C invalid = north” rule is too broad, and A cannot be treated as the general north fallback.
- No accepted B (priority desk) cases yet. Do not infer B’s rule.
- Amount, sender, urgency, wording, and retry status have not shown a reliable override; request type combined with region is currently the strongest observed pattern.

Routing notes:
- Routing is not determined by region alone; request type (and possibly other attributes) matters.
- Option C is confirmed valid for EAST renewal (REQ-2403, REQ-2422, REQ-2425, REQ-2427) and EAST shipment (REQ-2407).
- Option C is invalid for EAST transfer (REQ-2411, REQ-2416), EAST small invoice (REQ-2419), and EAST refund (REQ-2426).
- Option C remains invalid for NORTH based on prior evidence; no successful north-C example.
- Option A is valid for NORTH invoice (REQ-2412) and NORTH large refund (REQ-2414).
- Option A is invalid for NORTH claim (REQ-2410, REQ-2413), NORTH shipment (REQ-2415, REQ-2417), SOUTH renewal (REQ-2418), and EAST refund (REQ-2426).
- Option D was accepted for NORTH small shipment (REQ-2420) and EAST large invoice (REQ-2428), but rejected for EAST large transfer (REQ-2421), EAST large claim (REQ-2423), SOUTH large claim (REQ-2424), and SOUTH large transfer (REQ-2429). D’s rule is not yet established.
- No accepted B (priority desk) cases. Do not infer B’s rule.
- Amount, sender, urgency, wording, and retry status have not shown a reliable override; region + request type remains the strongest observed pattern.
- Do not use “C = east,” “C invalid = north,” or A as a general north fallback. For unseen combinations, avoid extrapolating from region alone.

Routing notes:

- Option C is valid for EAST renewal (REQ-2403, 2422, 2425, 2427) and EAST shipment (REQ-2407).
- Option C is invalid for EAST transfer (REQ-2411, 2416, 2433), EAST small invoice (REQ-2419), and EAST refund (REQ-2426, 2438). C remains unsupported for NORTH.
- Option A is valid for NORTH invoice (REQ-2412), NORTH large refund (REQ-2414), NORTH small refund (REQ-2439), SOUTH small transfer (REQ-2430), SOUTH small refund (REQ-2431), and EAST small transfer (REQ-2433).
- Option A is invalid for NORTH claim (REQ-2410, 2413), NORTH shipment (REQ-2415, 2417), SOUTH renewal (REQ-2418), and EAST refund (REQ-2426).
- Option B has one accepted case: NORTH small claim (REQ-2434). Its rule is unknown; do not generalize.

- Option D is invalid for EAST large transfer (REQ-2421), EAST large claim (REQ-2423), EAST large refund (REQ-2438), SOUTH large claim (REQ-2424), SOUTH large transfer (REQ-2429), SOUTH small transfer (REQ-2435), and SOUTH large renewal (REQ-2437). D’s broader rule remains unestablished.
- Amount, sender, urgency, wording, and retry status have not shown reliable override effects. Avoid using “C = east,” “C invalid = north,” or A as a general NORTH fallback.

- Option C: valid for EAST renewals (REQ-2403, 2422, 2425, 2427, 2451) and EAST shipments (REQ-2407, 2447). Invalid for EAST transfers (REQ-2411, 2416, 2433), EAST small invoices (REQ-2419, 2440, 2442), EAST refunds (REQ-2426, 2438), SOUTH renewals (REQ-2444, 2454); unsupported for NORTH. - Option A: valid for NORTH invoices (REQ-2412, 2456, 2463), NORTH large/small refunds (REQ-2414, 2439, 2446), NORTH small renewal (REQ-2449, 2464), SOUTH small transfer (REQ-2430, 2443), SOUTH small refund (REQ-2431, 2452, 2462), SOUTH large refund (REQ-2458), and EAST small transfer (REQ-2433, 2467). - Option C: valid for EAST renewals (REQ-2403, 2422, 2425, 2427, 2451), shipments (REQ-2407, 2447, 2478). Invalid for EAST transfers (REQ-2411, 2416, 2433), small invoices (REQ-2419, 2440, 2442), refunds (REQ-2426, 2438); SOUTH renewals (REQ-2444, 2454); unsupported for NORTH.
- Option A: valid for NORTH invoices (REQ-2412, 2456, 2463), refunds (REQ-2414, 2439, 2446, 2479), small renewals (REQ-2449, 2464, 2470, 2476); SOUTH small transfers (REQ-2430, 2443, 2471) and refunds (REQ-2431, 2452, 2462, 2474), large refund (REQ-2458); EAST small transfers (REQ-2433, 2467). Invalid for NORTH claims, shipments, other listed renewals, large transfers; EAST refunds/small invoices.
- Option B: accepted for claims—NORTH small/large (REQ-2434, 2448), SOUTH large (REQ-2441, 2450) and small (REQ-2473), EAST small/large (REQ-2453, 2455, 2460, 2469)—and EAST large refund (REQ-2472). Claim pattern is strong but not formally generalized.
- Option D: valid for NORTH small/large shipments (REQ-2420, 2459), NORTH large invoice (REQ-2463; conflicts with A evidence), EAST large/small invoices (REQ-2428, 2465, 2468, 2475), SOUTH large/small invoices (REQ-2436, 2445, 2461, 2477). Invalid for listed EAST large transfer/claim/refund and SOUTH transfer/claim/renewal cases.

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on region, request type, and size. Do not generalize from region alone. Wording, sender, urgency, scanned/typed status, and retry status have not shown reliable override effects.
- Option C: valid for EAST renewals, shipments (including large: REQ-2485), and listed shipments/renewals. Invalid for EAST transfers, small invoices, refunds; SOUTH renewals; unsupported for NORTH.
- Option A: valid for NORTH invoices, refunds, small renewals (REQ-2484), and SOUTH transfers (small and large: REQ-2480, REQ-2486), refunds; EAST small transfers. Invalid for NORTH claims, small transfers (REQ-2489), shipments, and other listed renewals; EAST refunds/small invoices; NORTH large transfers; large transfers elsewhere unless evidenced.
- Option B: accepted for claims—NORTH small/large, SOUTH small/large, EAST small/large—and EAST large refunds. Also accepted for EAST small refund (REQ-2482), despite prior EAST refund examples marked invalid for A/C. Claim pattern remains strong but not formally generalized.
- Option D: valid for NORTH shipments (small/large), NORTH large transfer (REQ-2487), NORTH large invoice (conflicts with A evidence), EAST invoices and large shipment/renewal-related cases as previously listed, and SOUTH invoices (including large: REQ-2483). Invalid for EAST small refund (REQ-2481), EAST large transfer/claim/refund, and listed SOUTH transfer/claim/renewal cases.
- Preserve conflicts rather than overgeneralize: NORTH large invoice has both A and D evidence. EAST refund routing may depend on size: large → B observed; small → B observed, while A/D/C were rejected or previously invalid.

Routing notes:

- Option D: valid for NORTH large transfers (REQ-2487 and REQ-2492), NORTH shipments (small/large), EAST invoices and listed large shipment/renewal-related cases, and SOUTH invoices (including large REQ-2483). NORTH large renewal rejected (REQ-2495); also invalid for EAST small refund, EAST large transfer/claim/refund, and listed SOUTH transfer/claim/renewal cases.
- Preserve conflicts: NORTH large invoice has both A and D evidence. EAST refund routing appears size-sensitive: B observed for both small and large, while A/D/C were rejected or previously invalid.

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on region, request type, and size; do not generalize from region alone. Wording, sender, urgency, scanned/typed status, and retry status have not shown reliable override effects.
- Option A: valid for NORTH small renewals, invoices (including large REQ-2502; D rejected), refunds (small REQ-2504), and listed cases; SOUTH transfers (small/large), refunds (small/large REQ-2505); EAST small transfers (REQ-2509). Invalid for NORTH claims, small transfers, and other evidenced exceptions; EAST refunds/small invoices; NORTH large transfers; large transfers elsewhere unless evidenced.
- Option B: accepted for NORTH/SOUTH claims, small and large (REQ-2503/2498), EAST refunds (small/large, including REQ-2507), and SOUTH large renewals (REQ-2508). Claim pattern is strong but not formally universal.
- Option C: valid for EAST renewals (small/large), EAST shipments (including large REQ-2490), SOUTH shipments (small REQ-2506 and large REQ-2497), and listed shipments/renewals. Invalid for EAST transfers, small invoices, refunds; SOUTH renewals (large now confirmed B); unsupported for NORTH.
- Option D: valid for NORTH shipments (small/large, including REQ-2501), NORTH large transfers (REQ-2487/2492), EAST invoices and listed large shipment/renewal-related cases, and SOUTH invoices (including large REQ-2483). NORTH large renewal rejected (REQ-2495). D is not valid for NORTH large invoice (REQ-2502), EAST small refund, EAST large transfer/claim/refund, or listed SOUTH transfer/claim/renewal cases.
- Preserve unresolved/size-sensitive exceptions only where evidence conflicts; EAST refunds are consistently B across sizes.

Routing notes:
- Routing depends on region, request type, and size; do not generalize from region alone. Wording, sender, urgency, scanned/typed status, and retry status remain unsupported as override factors.
- Option A: valid for NORTH small renewals and invoices (including large REQ-2502; D rejected), refunds (small REQ-2504), SOUTH small/large transfers and refunds (including large REQ-2505), EAST small transfers (REQ-2512; reinforces this pattern). Invalid for NORTH claims and transfers (including small REQ-2514), EAST invoices (small REQ-2510), EAST refunds, and other evidenced exceptions.
- Option B: accepted for NORTH/SOUTH claims, small and large (REQ-2503/2498; NORTH small REQ-2516), EAST refunds (small/large, including REQ-2507), and SOUTH large renewals (REQ-2508). Claim pattern is strong but not formally universal.
- Option C: valid for EAST renewals (small/large), EAST shipments (including large REQ-2490 and REQ-2517), SOUTH shipments (small/large, including REQ-2506/2497 and REQ-2511/2513/2519). Invalid for EAST transfers, small invoices, and refunds; SOUTH renewals; unsupported for NORTH.
- Option D: valid for NORTH shipments (small/large, REQ-2501), NORTH large transfers (REQ-2487/2492), EAST invoices (now confirmed small REQ-2510), and SOUTH invoices (small/large, including REQ-2483 and REQ-2518). NORTH large renewal rejected (REQ-2495). D is invalid for NORTH large invoice (REQ-2502), EAST refunds, and listed EAST large transfer/claim cases.
- Preserve unresolved/size-sensitive exceptions only where evidence conflicts. EAST refunds remain consistently B across sizes; SOUTH shipments remain C across sizes.
